class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessorABC):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""

    def apply_object_preselection(self, variation):

        Build MuonGood collection: muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4

import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.workflows.base import BaseProcessorABC


class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessorABC):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""

    def apply_object_preselection(self, variation):
        """
        Build MuonGood collection: muons with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4
        """
        muon_mask = (self.events.Muon.pt > 15) & (abs(self.events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        self.events["MuonGood"] = self.events.Muon[muon_mask]

    def count_objects(self, variation):
        """
        Store the number of selected muons per event.
        """
        self.events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)
